channel.title: Insyde Software — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by Insyde Software (insyde).

item.title: CVE-2021-38489 · 8.2 HIGH — HDD Password Stored In Plaintext
item.description: HDD password plaintext is stored in a UEFI variable.

item.title: CVE-2021-43614 · 6.7 MEDIUM — VariableEditSmm: Error checking of UEFI variables could cause buffer overflow, leading to code execution
item.description: Error in handling the PlatformLangCodes UEFI variable could cause a buffer overflow, leading to resource exhaustion and failure.

item.title: CVE-2021-43613 · 6.5 MEDIUM — SysPasswordDxe: Password hashes are exposed in runtime UEFI variables, leading to escalation of privilege
item.description: An issue was discovered in SysPasswordDxe in Insyde InsydeH2O. User and administrator password hashes are exposed in runtime UEFI variables, leading to escalation of privilege

item.title: CVE-2026-9805 · 2.7 LOW — FMTSWriteUseIntelLib: FMTS SMM IHISI Buffer Overflow
item.description: SMM IHISI command handler, FMTSWriteUseIntelLib, for FMTS command 0x32, read and write data without checking buffer size and could cause buffer overflow.

item.title: CVE-2026-8810 · 6.9 MEDIUM — HDD Password leakage vulnerability
item.description: On ARM platforms, a vulnerability in the architecture design of HDD Password could allow an attacker to retrieve HDD Password from UEFI variables.

item.title: CVE-2026-6484 · 8.2 HIGH — Lack of verified boot to certain FV may cause arbitrary code execution
item.description: In an UEFI, Lack of verified boot to certain FV may cause arbitrary code execution.

item.title: CVE-2025-12053 · 7.8 HIGH — egwindrvx64.sys is potentially vulnerable to a buffer overflow
item.description: The drivers in the tool packages use RTL_QUERY_REGISTRY_DIRECT flag to read a registry value to which an untrusted user-mode application may be able to cause a buffer overflow.

item.title: CVE-2025-10451 · 8.2 HIGH — H19Int15CallbackSmm: SMM memory corruption vulnerability in combined DXE/SMM (SMRAM write)
item.description: Unchecked output buffer may allowed arbitrary code execution in SMM and potentially result in SMM memory corruption.

item.title: CVE-2025-4410 · 7.5 HIGH — SetupUtility: A buffer overflow vulnerability leads to arbitrary code execution.
item.description: A buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the module SetupUtility. An attacker with local privileged access can exploit this vulnerability by executeing arbitrary code.

item.description: Tcg2Smm has a vulnerability which can be used to write arbitrary memory inside SMRAM and execute arbitrary code at SMM level.
